_format: Project-scope precedents for pi-kit, merged with the protocol-scope file at run start.

precedents.rule: 'Working as expected' includes data truthfulness: helm UI must never claim success or completion before the underlying command/handoff actually completes; suppression/optimistic states must be justified against a completion receipt.
precedents.provenance: run 1 interpretation delta (~60% of fixes were data-layer); run 2 R3 'UI claiming success before command completion'

precedents.rule: helm screens keep the terminal-native background — #17181c is a design token for mocks, never painted over the terminal's own background.
Worktrees and branches belonging to an in-flight fable-loop run (planfile status not terminal) are never stale — loops must not flag or clean them.
precedents.provenance: test-loop trial 20260718: flagged run 3's live worktrees as stale; user ruled ignore-as-precedent
